text: Karen was a high school student who disliked school and maintained barely passing grades. A few weeks before the end of the term, her father promised to pay for a vacation to Hawaii if she earned top marks on her final graduation requirements. After receiving this exciting promise, Karen became so obsessed with the prospect of Hawaii that she spent the remaining weeks shopping for summer clothes, making travel itineraries, and daydreaming about the beach instead of studying for her exams. When exam week arrived, she was completely unprepared. As a result, Karen failed her final tests, was denied graduation, and did not receive the trip to Hawaii. She argued angrily with her father about the decision, but the vacation was canceled.
